name: How can I tell if my existing windows need to be replaced with double-pane windows?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my existing windows need to be replaced with double-pane windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your windows may need replacement include drafts, noticeable temperature fluctuations near windows, condensation between the glass panes (indicating a failed seal), difficulty opening or closing, or visible damage to frames or glass. If you have single-pane windows, upgrading to double-pane will almost always improve energy efficiency and comfort. An energy audit can also highlight heat loss through older windows, signaling a need for an upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, condensation between panes, or difficulty operating. Single-pane windows often warrant an upgrade for better efficiency.
